The issuer shows exceptionally strong short-term liquidity (current ratio of 12.41) and strong operating performance relative to revenue (EBIT/operating income of 3,188M on 7,300M revenue), supporting debt service capacity. However, leverage is high with total liabilities of 444,085M versus equity of 49,234M, which constrains the rating despite the favorable liquidity and profitability.

DECISION: BBB
